prompt_md: Class A has 10 students who averaged 80 on a test. Class B has 30 students who averaged 60. What's the average score of all 40 students?
hint_md: Add up all the points first.
explain_intuition_md: Class B has three times as many students, so its 60 pulls the overall average much harder. Averaging the two class averages to get 70 ignores the class sizes.
